controls: Independent route, estimate and journal review
Versioned accounting policy and disclosure review
guidance: The accounting review is unresolved in the areas listed below; completed workpapers are retained.
limitations: Accounting source/target data-integrity workpaper only; no production migration, database/ERP write, access change or technical-completeness certification.
Actual legal applicability, risk severity and precision remain qualified judgments; an RCM or test plan is not testing evidence.
Company recognition, valuation, legal rights and tax conclusions require supplied evidence and independent review. No universal ERP posting authorization is inferred.
Contract clearing journals require mapping to the contract-specific asset/liability accounts; do not offset different contracts.
Control design and evidence readiness only; no operating-effectiveness, audit/ICFR opinion, management certification or SOX compliance conclusion.
Mappings, accounting conclusions, control thresholds and system metadata must be independently supplied; this is not a reporting/FP&A or generic engineering engine.
Precise authority is not asserted where the governed register has no verified paragraph; apply actual effective edition and entity scope.
Qualified actual sources and current framework/period review required. No actuarial, legal, audit or external compliance certification.

Rates and functional currency are reviewed inputs. Monetary FX is not eliminated merely because an intragroup balance is eliminated. Hyperinflation, exchangeability, net investments and hedges require specialist methods.
open_items: inventory: Contradictory INVENTORY_GL evidence requires rework
reporting: Apply US nonpublic, UK small entity and AASB tier relief only when eligible
Class gross/accumulated rollforwards, depreciation methods/lives, impairment, disposals and CIP commitments; AASB Tier2 disclosures use applicable reduced-disclosure requirements.
Contract cost balances, amortization and impairment
Framework-specific statement presentation and comparative-period consistency
Material accrual estimates, corrections, subsequent events and presentation changes require financial reporting review.
Material accrual uncertainty, expense/asset classification, related parties and supplier financing require separate disclosure review.
Performance obligations, payment terms and remaining obligations
Policies, movements, significant judgments and unrecognized or specialist-dependent exposures
Rate-source uncertainty and lack-of-exchangeability disclosures where relevant
Reviewed operative-framework disclosure checklist; source and GL amounts tie to statement/note population
Timing, progress, price constraint and SSP judgments
Transaction FX gains/losses separate from translation OCI
